convert_sensors_to_gym_space: convert a list of 1D BoxSpaceSensors into a single gym Box observation space
convert_1d_box_sensors_to_gym_space: convert 1D BoxSpaceSensors with uniform dtypes into a concatenated gym Box space
convert_sensors_to_gym_space_dictionary: convert a list of sensors into a gym Dict space keyed by sensor names
create_constant_action: create a uniform value action array or dictionary matching a gym action space shape
action_astype: recursively cast an action array or dictionary of actions to a specified numpy dtype
